host.title: Host
host.description: The host address of your MySQL database.

port.title: Port
port.description: The port used for connecting to your MySQL database. The default port for MySQL is 3306, but your port might be different.

user.title: User
user.description: The user name for accessing your MySQL database.

database.title: Database
database.description: The name of a database in your MySQL account.

max_size.title: Max batch size for parquet files
max_size.description: Batch size for target s3 parquet

password.title: Password
password.description: The password used for accessing your MySQL database.

chunk_size.title: Chunk size
chunk_size.description: The number of rows to fetch at a time. If set to 0, the tap will fetch all rows at once (no chunking).

filter_schemas.title: Include schemas
filter_schemas.description: Filter the schemas you want to sync from your database. Using this filter helps speed up the discovery process, since schemas that aren't included in the filter will be ignored.

config_template.connector_description: Connect MySQL with Nekt to seamlessly manage and analyze your relational database data. Utilize Nekt’s powerful data hub to perform complex queries, create custom visualizations, and streamline your operations.
